Plot the temporal mean of an ACI variable over a sub-period

Source: R/visualization.R
plot_aci_map_mean.Rd

Convenience wrapper around plot_aci_map that computes the mean over a user-defined date range rather than a single time index.

Usage

plot_aci_map_mean(
  data,
  variable = "ACI",
  period = NULL,
  country_abbrev = NULL,
  admin_level = NULL,
  crs_metric = NULL,
  var_label = "Standardised anomaly",
  title = NULL,
  palette = "RdBu",
  reverse = TRUE,
  n_breaks = 9,
  borders = TRUE
)

Arguments

data

Bare array, grid-cell list, or admin data.frame.

variable

Variable to map. Default "ACI". Ignored when data is already a bare array.

period

Character vector c("start", "end") in the same format as the time field of data (e.g. c("2000-01", "2010-12") for monthly). If NULL (default), uses the full time range.

country_abbrev

Three-letter ISO code.

admin_level

Integer or NULL.

crs_metric

EPSG code. Default NULL (read from attributes, falling back to 4326).

var_label

Colour-bar label.

title

Plot title.

palette

RColorBrewer palette. Default "RdBu".

reverse

Logical. Default TRUE.

n_breaks

Integer. Default 9.

borders

Logical. Default TRUE.

Value

A ggplot object.
